bounded_authorization: §13.3.7 SOSA AMPs Rules only; stop BEFORE §13.3.8

original_source_items.source_meaning_paraphrase: Section titled SOSA AMPs Rules contains four printed Rules, one Observation and one Permission; §13.3.8 begins PDF266.
original_source_items.scope_caveat: Source applies to specified SOSA PIC/plug-in module AMPS physical ports and lanes; neither universal sensing system equipment nor native CSAPI data encoding, installed card inventory, current state, adopted DIM/Profile requirement or independent conformance.

original_source_items.source_meaning_paraphrase: Where SOSA Plug-In Card (PIC) has Low Voltage Differential Signal (LVDS) on Expansion plane, lane allocation begins at lowest lane of highest-numbered Expansion-plane port; only applies when that LVDS condition exists.
original_source_items.scope_caveat: Source applies to specified SOSA PIC/plug-in module AMPS physical ports and lanes; neither universal sensing system equipment nor native CSAPI data encoding, installed card inventory, current state, adopted DIM/Profile requirement or independent conformance.
original_source_items.conditional_scope_caveat: Conditional LVDS placement; not every PIC uses LVDS and not every sensor has an Expansion plane.

original_source_items.source_meaning_paraphrase: A SOSA PIC's AMPS String follows either 3U or 6U Payload Plug-In Card Profile (PICP) format Table13.3.4-1 or Table13.3.4-2, or Switch PICP format Table13.3.5-1, according to its physical profile.
original_source_items.scope_caveat: Source applies to specified SOSA PIC/plug-in module AMPS physical ports and lanes; neither universal sensing system equipment nor native CSAPI data encoding, installed card inventory, current state, adopted DIM/Profile requirement or independent conformance.
original_source_items.conditional_scope_caveat: Original Rule uses MUST rather than SHALL. Underlying matrices earlier source text reviewed, exact dense visual legal-port coordinates not verified; no full conformance claim.

original_source_items.source_meaning_paraphrase: Plug-in module implements every port and every lane for associated protocols that its own AMPS String specifies.
original_source_items.scope_caveat: Source applies to specified SOSA PIC/plug-in module AMPS physical ports and lanes; neither universal sensing system equipment nor native CSAPI data encoding, installed card inventory, current state, adopted DIM/Profile requirement or independent conformance.
original_source_items.conditional_scope_caveat: Binding on claimed AMPS design, not a mandate to have every possible SOSA port, protocol or complete vendor-verified installation.

original_source_items.source_meaning_paraphrase: For plug-in modules whose ports can be configured for multiple protocols, implement lanes for every protocol specified by the AMPS String.
original_source_items.scope_caveat: Source applies to specified SOSA PIC/plug-in module AMPS physical ports and lanes; neither universal sensing system equipment nor native CSAPI data encoding, installed card inventory, current state, adopted DIM/Profile requirement or independent conformance.
original_source_items.conditional_scope_caveat: Conditional on configurable multi-protocol ports; Observation 13.3.7-1 illustrates lane repartition exception when expressly specified subset.

original_source_items.source_meaning_paraphrase: Illustrative 40GBASE-KR4/10GBASE-KR single Fat Pipe configurable protocol E84E7: when set to 10GBASE-KR, repartition into four UTPs each implementing 10GBASE-KR, unless AMPS explicitly indicates a subset of Fat Pipe lanes.
original_source_items.scope_caveat: Source applies to specified SOSA PIC/plug-in module AMPS physical ports and lanes; neither universal sensing system equipment nor native CSAPI data encoding, installed card inventory, current state, adopted DIM/Profile requirement or independent conformance.
original_source_items.exception: subset of lanes when explicitly specified in source AMPS

exact_holds.reason: Rule2 references Tables13.3.4-1/-2 and13.3.5-1; prior G2-7C/G2-7D source text inventory does not verify full high-res port/protocol cell geometry, so no full legal-combination audit.
Complete original ANSI/VITA65.0/65.1 slot profile and Alternate Naming Structure definitions not inspected; source pointer alone is not audit.
Original referenced VITA optical and RF connector specifications remain unread; no independent intermateability conformance.
Original C239 DSDM/IDL/six OpenAPI native companion file content not inspected, no schema fields or software protocol behavior inferred.
Original prints numbered Rule with 'must' rather than 'shall'; preserve verb without editorial normative upgrade or downgrading.
Where LVDS exists on expansion plane, prescribed lane position applies; do not infer every PIC necessarily uses LVDS.
All ports/lanes required by this Rule refer to those specified by a particular AMPS String, not all theoretically possible ports on all sensors.
Requirement conditional on multi-protocol configurable ports, and the source Observation's explicit subset-lanes exception must not be silently erased.
Observation 13.3.7-1 example of 40/10G Ethernet repartitioning has 'must' narrative but is not a separately numbered Rule/SHALL.
Permission 13.3.7-1 optionally combines EP1/EP2 for PCI Express only; not blanket mandatory arrangement.
Print original A for Rules1/2 and A,D for Rules3/4; this source review did not perform methodology A/D on actual hardware.
Original project Library original text directly read, but independent original PDF page-image retrieval failed; keep read grade inline text, no source pixel audit assertion.
All 19 G2-7C, 17 G2-7D and 16 G2-7E specific holds remain open; this packet does not close them.
Dragino, AirGradient, Campbell and Bennett case originals do not prove actual SOSA PICP cards, LVDS plane, or compliant lane/port arrays.
2025 S251 edition/snapshot source and companions remain unexamined; no claim on current changed Rule text.
Original SOSA Rule cannot become adopted DIM chassis/class, cardinality, CSAPI Profile SHALL or independent producer/client conformance without separate decisions.
Original §13.3.8 backplane analog/optical apertures beyond authorized scope; distinct source packet requires new Proceed.
